1900.s: There they were, of every age and sex; some asleep, with Welsh wigs and red pocket handkerchiefs screening their heads from cold, and their ears as well as might be from uproar; some were endeavouring to read by the light of mutton candles, with wicks like a light infantry feather,…

1910.s: This jacket is wadded inside with a wool like that one makes Welsh wigs of; and though not handsome, amazing comfortable, with pockets all over.
1910.au: The Fitz-Boodle papers, and other sketches. | $c: With illus. by Harry Furniss, etc.
